Yao Bikuni  is a minor antagonist in Taimanin RPGX.

She is a Taimanin and very old member of the Fuuma clan, that joined the Nisha Ninja Troops in Taimanin RPGX.



Personality
Yao refuses to answer anything about her age, saying not to ask a woman that is a "time-honored and unwritten rule". She keeps to herself, remaining mysterious but holds a grudge against some people. Yao talks old-fashioned and is normally polite in tone but has displayed multiple times cruelty.

She was a loyal member to Fuuma Danjo and now Nisha Gaiza. However, thinks Fuuma Kotaro who she calls "blind lord", is an abomination more than other members. She seems to dislike him.

Appearance
She has white skin, purple eyes and long dark blue hair.

History
Background
An old Taimanin of the Fuuma clan.

It is said that she has been in the service of the Fuuma family since the ancient Fuuma Kotaro the first. If this is true, then she has lived for 500 years. Served as Fuuma Danjo's advisors next to Fuuma Saika.

Saved, Fuuma Kotaro, Fuuma Tokiko and Nisha Gaiza in the year 2068 from orders of the Elders of the Igawa clan, which started an extermination of the Fuuma after the failed takeover of Fuuma Danjo. She appeared in the year 2070, helping the Igawa clan of Asagi against the Igawa Revolt Group, as Asagi was the one that stopped the Elders in the past. Taking Fuuma Tokiko, Yaguruma Yaemon and other Fuuma clan leftovers with her to help.

Timeline RPGX
She later joined Nisha Gaiza and his Nisha Ninja Troops in the year 2082, looking not a day aged. Yao like other members of that group are exiled from Gosha Village and she supports the quest of Gaiza to take over the village and gain current power in the criminal underworld of Tokyo Kingdom.

When, their group spread the CD Virus to obtain the turf of Dragon Gate, she was with Nisha Gaiza. As the Independent Commando Unit caught up to them, Yao Bikuni fought the group on their own, but with the additional assistance of the Ryomanin, Yomi Akitsu she was defeated. However, as Gaiza appeared the tables were turned once again, after Fuuma Kotaro was given a deadly wound, both disappeared. She, afterward, appeared in minor events.

In year 2087, Yao was sent out, as part of a group of multiple executives including, Kuroki Shizuku, Onigumo Saburo and Yaguruma Yaemon, to take down Poison Claw Toruko in Yomihara. The leftover of Fürst, was attacked by them as they got ready to submit to Lina, and most of their members were killed. As Toruko lied broken on the floor, both Shizuku and Saburo lost interest in the fight, while Bikuni still wished to kill her, Yaemon took the girl to "have fun with" which was good enough for Bikuni, but still assumed she would be killed.

In the year 2088, as Tokyo Kingdom was in the state of chaos as Nisha Gaiza started a killing spree to empower himself, as he and Teutates to double-cross each other. Bikuni, together with the other executives, were told to remain in Yomihara and defend the turf with their lives, not informed beyond that. Even Bikuni confused about the current state of things, as the group sat together complaining, Yaguruma Yaemon arrived with Shinganji Kurenai, which informed them about the possibility of a fake Gaku Shonosuke which had given Gaiza the idea of the rampage. Kagari (Kurenai's subordinate) having spotted Shonosuke during a conversation between him and Teutates forces. A phone call of Clone Asagi further confirmed the matter, with Gaku Shonosuke being found in a Task Force G connected mansion of Ares. Near death, Clone Asagi found the man and now had given him over to the Kiryu Mikoto to heal. Most of the members, together with Kurenai, made their way to Tokyo Kingdom, but arrived as late as Gaiza had already transformed himself into a demon. Despite the first shock, the executives all insisted they were still loyal to him. As Kotaro had been beaten down, his allies used the chance to escape, with the executives following behind.

Fought against Felicia, as Gaiza confronted Teutates. Damaged her own arm, in the hope her Evil Eye could overwhelm Felica but was fully outmatched. Felicia continued to hack at Yao's body, telling her she would make her stronger to be more fun, until nothing was left but her eye. Which Felicia considered taking as a souvenir.


Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Staff

Ninja Art: "Evil Eye", "Mermaid's Sapphires Eyes" sucks the life energy out of anything she sees with her right eye and uses it as her own energy. When the life energy is taken away, the target is said to turn into a monster like a half-fish. Her ability grows in strength the more wounds she has.
Particle Control: Taimanin are able to manipulate Taima Particles to enhance their physical strength, speed and defense. The particles are also used to counter demonic influences and strengthen damage to demons.

Trivia
She is named after "Yao Bikuni (Happyaku Bikuni)" from the folk stories "Eight-hundred (years) Buddhist priestess". A character connected to mermaids/fish people and living extremely long. Her nun like design may also come from that story, though it is not clear if she supposed to be the same folk stories version, in universe.
